build.reason: The recipe requests the CMake target cmark_static, but the supplied top-level CMake file delegates target definitions to an unsupplied src/CMakeLists.txt. The Dockerfile also copies a *.dict build-context file whose contents are not supplied.

lifecycle.reason: The target finishes and frees the streaming parser, then renders and frees the returned document. The parser free path does not free its returned root; document and conversion helpers likewise retain the document until their documented cleanup calls.
